description: Shared Renovate preset for all kupecloud repos. Lives here, in a PUBLIC repo, because a preset hosted in a private repo cannot be resolved by public repos — Renovate fails with "Cannot find preset's package" and stops raising PRs for them entirely. Consume with: {"extends": ["local>kupecloud/github-workflows//renovate/default"]}

prBodyNotes: 🛡️  **Security update** — Renovate raised this PR in response to a vulnerability advisory affecting one or more direct or transitive dependencies.
The 7-day quarantine and the cadence schedule are bypassed for security-driven updates so the fix can be reviewed and merged promptly.
Review the advisory details below and the linked CVE before merging.
⚠️  **Review release notes for breaking changes before merging.**
All Renovate PRs in this org require human review — automerge is disabled per security policy.

customManagers.description: Inline image strings — catches `image: <registry>/<path>:<tag>(@<digest>)?` in any values.yaml that is NOT in the standard nested image.repository/image.tag form. Currently used by vcluster/values.yaml (vcluster-generic-sync-plugin) and console/chart/values/{dev,prod}.yaml (headlamp + console + console-metrics-plugin). Renovate's helm-values manager handles the standard nested form natively; this regex catches the inline-string deviations.

Argocd gitRevision in values/prod.yaml — pins prod ApplicationSet refs to git tag SHAs with a trailing `# vX.Y.Z` comment. Renovate updates both the SHA and the comment together when a new release tag exists in the source repo. managerFilePatterns is evaluated relative to the scanned repo's root (in kupecloud/argocd the file is values/prod.yaml), so it is deliberately wide; the matchString's kupecloud repoURL requirement scopes it. Both keys are line-anchored (^\s* cannot cross a #) so commented-out example entries never bind to real gitRevision lines. Dev values use `gitRevision: main` which has no version concept.

Argo Application chart pins in Helm values that reference a kupecloud chart repo by RELEASE TAG (`targetRevision: "vX.Y.Z"`) — the kupe-control-operator's per-tenant vcluster / cluster-base / alloy-tenant Application templates. The values file has no repoURL next to every pin (env overlays override only targetRevision), so the dependency is declared on the preceding line with a `# renovate: github-releases=kupecloud/<repo>` marker; Renovate bumps the tag when a new release exists. Line-anchored so unrelated `targetRevision: main` entries (dev) never bind. Added 2026-08-18 — the operator values comment had claimed Renovate coverage that did not exist.

packageRules.description: First-party kupecloud images bypass the 7-day quarantine AND the weekly cadence. We control the build, so a new tag is trusted as soon as it lands on GHCR. Enables the internal-dep cascade (e.g. console-metrics-plugin release immediately raises a PR in the console repo). Still requires human review (no automerge). Detection latency is bounded by the Mend hosted App's scan cadence (~4h on the Community tier).

Self-hosted GitHub Actions runner image — bypasses BOTH the 7-day quarantine and the weekly cadence. GitHub stops queuing jobs to a runner more than 30 days past a release, and ARC converts the resulting exit-code-7 into a TERMINAL Outdated state that deletes the scale set's listener and its GitHub-side registration, recoverable only by a spec change (not a restart). A stale pin here is a CI OUTAGE, not a missed feature: it cost ~6 days of prod CI on 2026-08-13, detected by Renovate but never opened as a PR. Weekly batching + 7-day quarantine + review latency can consume most of the 30-day budget, so these are proposed the moment they are detected. Human review still applies. Backstop: the runner-version freshness alert in kupecloud/observability.
prBodyNotes: ⏰ **CI availability deadline** — GitHub stops queuing jobs to self-hosted runners more than 30 days past a runner release. Merging this late causes a full CI outage that cannot be fixed by restarting anything; see the failure-chain comment on the `FROM` line in kupecloud/github-runners `Dockerfile`.

packageRules.description: Block major version bumps from auto-merge AND add explicit warnings in the PR body. Already prevented from automerge by the global no-automerge stance, but the warning helps reviewers triage major bumps as breaking-by-default.
prBodyNotes: 🚨 **MAJOR VERSION BUMP** — review breaking changes carefully before merging.
Run `helm template` (for chart bumps), `go test ./...` (for Go deps), `npm run build` (for Node deps), or the relevant local validation before approving.

packageRules.description: Custom regex manager updates (inline image strings + argocd gitRevisionProd) — same review policy as helm-values, with a label so they are easy to identify in the PR list.

Group Dockerfile base-image DIGEST refreshes per repo into a single PR on the org cadence (weekly default). Tag updates (X.Y.Z to X.Y.Z+1) still get their own per-image PRs because those are real version bumps, not digest churn. This rule is what makes Layer 3 base-image digest pinning manageable.
Helm chart dep updates — explicitly NOT grouped (per-component PRs). Each chart bump gets its own PR.
Helm chart MAJOR bumps add the helm-major label for filtering.
Label Docker base image updates (dockerfile manager).
